description.value:
A sweet and tangy dessert made of lemon juice and red caviar.
The original recipe included a herring, which emitted a pungent odor disliked by the public. The negative feedback resulted in the current version containing only red caviar.

"They never said it was a canned herring!"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Affected creatures gain +1 AC and +1 to Constitution saves. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Increase DEF of all allies by 25% in the next battle.
